subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new Gateway-backed editable Control UI dictation feature now, and should this branch be rebased onto the current chat composer architecture before further review?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing microphone workflow and authenticated audio RPC that uses provider credentials and temporary files; automation can flag defects, but only maintainers can accept that product/security boundary and current architecture direction.

options.title: Proceed after rebase, fix, and proof
options.body: Keep the Gateway/media-audio direction, require adaptation to the current chat composer, fix the alert label, and require redacted successful real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind broader voice direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle the broader provider-backed WebChat STT/TTS direction tracked elsewhere.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Close or decline the core feature surface and ask for a smaller follow-up only if maintainers later sponsor it.

recommendation.title: Proceed after rebase, fix, and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the Gateway/media-audio direction, require adaptation to the current chat composer, fix the alert label, and require redacted successful real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal for prior server-side dictation and the Gateway-backed voice boundary this PR extends.
